title: Show the project emblem in the desktop menu
changes: Replace the original sidebar crest with the FFTA DE-ReBuild emblem, rendered at multiple cached sizes and independent of menu background transparency.
validation: Linux offscreen menu test passed at 480x360, 640x480, 854x480 and 1920x1080 with opaque and transparent backgrounds. Existing video-menu test and visual inspection of its 640x480 capture passed.
limitations: No Windows or live game runtime validation performed; Linux build used the installed Wayland runtime with temporary pkg-config and linker metadata.
